Talent catalog

Filter the entire character talent inventory.

1,764 nodes across 49 trees. Each tree has 36 nodes, 92 legally purchasable ranks and a 59-point budget.

Node count is not evidence of depth. The playstyle rubric and unresolved binding flags remain part of this specification.

Decisive Window
Warrior 		Tier 4
Level 32
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. The first direct primary action against an enemy below 25% health, or a healing recipient below 40%, gains 2% output per rank. Six-second internal cooldown; no gain from overhealing or overkill. Ranked
shared rule contract
Efficient Setup
Warrior 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. After two distinct successful owned ability families in six seconds, reduce the next paid primary action cost by 2% per rank. One consumption per sequence; periodic ticks are not new families. Ranked
shared rule contract
Extended Setup
Warrior 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. Extend an eligible non-control owner mark or preparation window by 0.5 seconds per rank, to at most 15 seconds. Where none exists, extend this tree's preparation consumption window by the same amount. Does not create extra periodic ticks. Ranked
shared rule contract
Careful Coverage
Warrior 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. Increase an owned non-control area radius by 0.1 units per rank while reducing per-target output by 1% per rank. Target caps and server interest rules still apply; without an area, extend normal primary range by 0.05 units per rank. Ranked
shared rule contract
Compact Coverage
Warrior 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. The primary action gains 2% per rank when it affects exactly one eligible target. For an area, actual server-selected target count is used; no targeting dummy or summoned-object loopholes. Ranked
shared rule contract
Coordinated Timing
Warrior 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Iron Cut. After another eligible player successfully acts on the same target, the next primary action within two seconds gains 1% per rank. Eight-second internal cooldown; pets and self-owned effects do not qualify. Ranked
shared rule contract

Warrior 		Tier 5

Efficient Setup
Saboteur 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Soot Charge. After two distinct successful owned ability families in six seconds, reduce the next paid primary action cost by 2% per rank. One consumption per sequence; periodic ticks are not new families. Ranked

Extended Setup

Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Soot Charge. Extend an eligible non-control owner mark or preparation window by 0.5 seconds per rank, to at most 15 seconds. Where none exists, extend this tree's preparation consumption window by the same amount. Does not create extra periodic ticks. Ranked
shared rule contract
Careful Coverage
Saboteur 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Soot Charge. Increase an owned non-control area radius by 0.1 units per rank while reducing per-target output by 1% per rank. Target caps and server interest rules still apply; without an area, extend normal primary range by 0.05 units per rank. Ranked
shared rule contract
Compact Coverage
Saboteur 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Soot Charge. The primary action gains 2% per rank when it affects exactly one eligible target. For an area, actual server-selected target count is used; no targeting dummy or summoned-object loopholes. Ranked
shared rule contract
Coordinated Timing
Saboteur 		Tier 5
Level 44
3 ranks		 Primary action: Soot Charge. After another eligible player successfully acts on the same target, the next primary action within two seconds gains 1% per rank. Eight-second internal cooldown; pets and self-owned effects do not qualify. Ranked
shared rule contract
